top_signals.title: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker destroys some inventory after more than $88 million stolen
top_signals.summary: The company behind a popular hardware wallet for bitcoin owners was forced to destroy part of its inventory after thieves siphoned more than $88 million from customers through a firmware vulnerability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: After Historic Intervention, 155 Emerges as Yen’s Next Big Test
top_signals.summary: Japan’s historic joint intervention with the US is shifting market focus to whether the yen can strengthen beyond 155 per dollar, a threshold strategists view as the key test for the rally’s staying power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: ‘Brilliant and provocative’ columnist and broadcaster Rod Liddle dies aged 66
top_signals.summary: The writer and broadcaster Rod Liddle has died at the age of 66.  Liddle, a titan of Fleet Street, died at hospital in Middlesbrough on Sunday evening following a short illness. The journalist, who wrote columns for The Sunday Times, The Spectator and The Sun, was previously the editor of BBC Radio 4’s Today programme. [...]
